name: Tm Visualization Suite: Multivariate Explorer
pitch: Compare many measures across hundreds of stores at once, and find the ones that behave differently.
question: Which measures move together, and which stores or items stand apart?
useWhen: Compare many measures for many items at once.
features: See every pair as its own plot
Follow each store across all measures

hero.alt: Correlation matrix of nine store measures for fiscal year 2025, blue for positive and red for negative links.
hero.caption: Which store measures move together, and which pull apart

screenshots.alt: Grid of small scatter plots for fiscal year 2025, one for each pair of store measures.
screenshots.caption: The scatter plots for one year show clusters and outliers

screenshots.alt: Parallel coordinates for fiscal year 2025 with one line for each store across seven measures.
screenshots.caption: The same stores in fiscal year 2025 follow a different pattern

questions: Which measures rise and fall together?
Which stores stand out across several measures?
How did the picture change from one year to the next?
audience: Analysts and BI leads who study many measures at once for stores, products or customers.

featureStrips.heading: Find which measures move together
featureStrips.text: A correlation matrix colours each pair of measures, so strong links and opposites show at a glance.
featureStrips.alt: Correlation matrix of nine store measures across all years, coloured from red to blue.

featureStrips.heading: See every pair as its own plot
featureStrips.text: A scatter plot matrix draws each pair of measures against each other, so you see the shape behind a number.
featureStrips.alt: Grid of small scatter plots, one for each pair of store measures.

featureStrips.heading: Follow each store across all measures
featureStrips.text: Parallel coordinates draw one line per store through every measure, so you see who is high on one and low on another.
featureStrips.alt: Parallel coordinates with one line for each store across seven measures.

featureStrips.heading: Compare one year with another
featureStrips.text: Select a year and the lines show only that year, so a change in pattern is easy to see.
featureStrips.alt: Parallel coordinates for fiscal year 2024 with one line for each store across seven measures.
